title: Wall Mount Double Glass Shelf 16-Inch With Gallery Rail Solid Brass | Antique Pewter | Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount Double Glass Shelf 16-Inch | Allied Brass, Antique Pewter
description:
Upgrade bathroom storage with a wall mount glass shelf that adds two levels of organization in a compact footprint in Antique Pewter, which offers a soft, silvery-gray tone with subtle warmth, bridging traditional and contemporary aesthetics. This double glass shelf features 3/8-inch thick tempered glass and a gallery rail designed to help keep items in place.

Highlights:
- Antique Pewter blends effortlessly with transitional decor
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Solid brass hardware supports enduring performance
- Gallery rail helps keep bottles and accessories from sliding off
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean look

Specs:
- Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 inches
- Overall size: 16 inches L x 5 inches W x 8 inches H (5-inch projection)
- Weight capacity: 4 lb
- Mounting: wall mount
- Assembly required: no
- Included: glass shelf and all installation hardware (screws: #8 x 1 1/4)

Design note: Part of the Waverly Place collection, suited to transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories, with multiple designer finish options available.
